audience: A frequent reader who manages a small personal shelf mainly on a phone.
request: Build a beautiful mobile-first reading app with the warmth and clarity of a good bookshop. The primary task is to find a book, open its details, and move it between reading states. Give it an individual visual identity and usable wide layout too.

facts.name: Margin
facts.tagline: A little room for the next chapter.

required_behavior: Search title or author and filter by reading state; show a useful empty state and reset.
Open each book detail and change its state between Want to read, Reading and Finished; shelf and counts must update.
Allow closing details with keyboard Escape and a visible control, and preserve sensible focus.
constraints: All books and authors are fictional demo data: do not imply real reviews, ratings or external availability.
Use original typographic covers or simple SVG artwork; no external assets/fonts/network requests.
Use system fonts; avoid fake inactive tabs or decorative controls that appear functional.
